phase1.note: Non-structural works only — no approvals required

scope: Remove load-bearing wall, replace with structural steel beams and columns
New concrete ground beams and strip footings
New RC retaining walls to rear
New 150mm RC slab at lower ground floor level
Localised underpinning of party wall foundations
New aluminium bi-fold doors + high-level window to rear
New retaining wall with planters and steps to rear garden
ACO drainage connected to existing system

workstreams.name: Party Wall
workstreams.summary: Lewisham dissented, appointed Andy Copper. Exploring agreed surveyor route. Two neighbours likely to dissent.

Served on Lewisham (freeholder of 30A, 30B, 32B) and separately on leaseholders
Lewisham dissented → appointed Andy Copper (Party Wall Works Ltd)
9 Mar: Nick asked Lewisham party wall team if Andy can act as agreed surveyor
9 Mar: Nick asked Andy if he can act as agreed surveyor for neighbours too
Two neighbours spoken to — both likely to want involvement; at least one uneasy
Nick does not yet have his own surveyor
workstreams.waitingOn: Andy Copper reply; Lewisham party wall reply re agreed surveyor
nickActions: If agreed surveyor route fails → appoint own surveyor (Jon Hicks / SSES preferred, from £695+VAT)

workstreams.name: Licence to Alter
workstreams.summary: Full LTA application submitted to Lewisham HOS. Awaiting officer assignment.

7 documents submitted: disclaimer, RAMS, insurance, architectural plans, structural plans/sections/spec
Lewisham auto-acknowledged — will respond within 2 working days with assigned officer and timeline
Key contact: Lianne Holland (Home Ownership Officer)
workstreams.waitingOn: Lewisham HOS — officer assignment and timeline (within 2 working days of 10 Mar)
